body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics showcased its stylish and innovative mobile phone ‘Rumor’ during CES 2008 (Booth #8214, Central Hall, Las Vegas Convention Center).

The Rumor by LG is the wireless experience at its best. Users can talk hands-free with the latest Bluetooth® technology or the full-duplex speakerphone, communicate with buddies using Instant Messaging or Mobile Email, or capture great close-ups using the camera and then send the photos to family and friends using Multimedia Messaging. Rumor’s lines of communication are always open.
